title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures diverge ahead of SK Hynix's mega US IPO
title_zh: 今日股市：道指、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货在 SK 海力士美国大型 IPO 之前出现分歧
summary: Stocks were on track for a choppy week as investors awaited the marquee SK Hynix US listing.
summary_zh: 由于投资者等待 SK 海力士在美国上市，股市将迎来动荡的一周。

title: UK to regulate cloud service providers Microsoft, Google and others to protect financial stability
title_zh: 英国将对微软、谷歌等云服务提供商进行监管，以保护金融稳定
summary: LONDON, July 10 () - Britain has designated cloud service providers Microsoft, Google, Amazon and Oracle as ‌critical third-party suppliers to its financial sector, bringing them ‌under direct regulatory oversight.
summary_zh: 伦敦，7 月 10 日 - 英国已指定云服务提供商微软、谷歌、亚马逊和甲骨文为其金融部门的关键第三方供应商，将它们置于直接监管之下。

title: A Month After SpaceX IPO, Tesla’s Stock Keeps Holding Its Ground
title_zh: SpaceX 首次公开募股一个月后，特斯拉股价保持坚挺
summary: (Bloomberg) -- In the weeks leading up to SpaceX’s monster IPO, many Wall Street pros feared the deal represented an existential threat for Elon Musk’s other giant, Tesla Inc. But after a month in the stock market, the outcome is far from clear.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——在 SpaceX 大规模首次公开募股（IPO）前的几周，许多华尔街专业人士担心这笔交易对埃隆·马斯克（Elon Musk）的另一家巨头特斯拉公司（Tesla Inc.）构成生存威胁。但在股市上市一个月后，结果还远未明朗。

title: Big Tech Doubles Debt Load to $350 Billion in AI Spending Spree
title_zh: 大型科技公司在人工智能方面的支出狂潮，债务负担翻了一番，达到 3500 亿美元
summary: (Bloomberg) -- The largest builders of artificial intelligence data centers have doubled their debt load in the last five years, turning to borrowing to finance an unprecedented spending spree they claim is needed to transform the economy.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——过去五年里，最大的人工智能数据中心建设者的债务负担增加了一倍，转向借贷来为他们声称的经济转型所需的前所未有的支出热潮提供资金。

title: Taiwanese chipmaker Nanya plans $6 billion in spending in 2027, riding AI boom
title_zh: 台湾芯片制造商南亚科技计划 2027 年支出 60 亿美元，乘势人工智能热潮
summary: Taiwanese memory chipmaker Nanya Technology said on Friday it plans capital spending of more than ‌T$200 billion ($6.2 billion) next year, roughly four times this year's figure, ‌amid soaring demand for memory chips as it rides an AI boom.
summary_zh: 台湾存储芯片制造商南亚科技周五表示，随着人工智能的蓬勃发展，存储芯片的需求不断飙升，该公司计划明年的资本支出超过 2000 亿新台币（合 62 亿美元），大约是今年数字的四倍。

title: Take Five: Chips, banks and volatility
title_zh: 要点五：筹码、银行和波动性
summary: July 10 (Reuters) - The results season is kicking off with the world's largest chipmaker and key U.S. banks reporting, while data out of the U.S. and China will give a fresh perspective on the state
summary_zh: 7 月 10 日（路透社）——随着全球最大的芯片制造商和美国主要银行发布财报，业绩季拉开序幕，而来自美国和中国的数据将为该州提供新的视角

title: SK Hynix's US listing, Delta earnings, housing bill: What to Watch
title_zh: SK 海力士在美国上市、达美航空盈利、住房账单：关注点
summary: Asking for a Trend Host Josh Lipton previews several of the biggest stories to come tomorrow, Friday, July 10, including SK Hynix (000660.KS) making its debut on the Nasdaq, Delta Air Lines (DAL) earnings, monthly sales results from Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.
summary_zh: 《寻求趋势》主持人乔希·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 预览了明天（即 7 月 10 日星期五）即将发布的几个重大新闻，包括 SK 海力士 (000660.KS) 在纳斯达克首次亮相、达美航空 (DAL) 财报、台积电月度销售业绩。

title: AI could cause a huge electricity shortfall in the US, Bank of America says: A closer look
title_zh: 美国银行表示，人工智能可能会导致美国出现巨大的电力短缺：仔细观察
summary: Bank of America (BAC) predicts that the US could face a major electricity shortage between 2026 and 2030. Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley breaks down the details.
summary_zh: 美国银行 (BAC) 预测，美国可能在 2026 年至 2030 年间面临严重的电力短缺。雅虎财经突发商业新闻记者杰克·康利 (Jake Conley) 详细分析了细节。

title: Apollo's Sløk: The market faces big risks if hyperscalers' AI profits get delayed
title_zh: Apollo 的 Sløk：如果超大规模企业的人工智能利润延迟，市场将面临巨大风险
summary: If hyperscaler cash flow can't accelerate as Wall Street expects, the market could face a series of risks, Apollo's Torsten Sløk says.
summary_zh: Apollo 的 Torsten Sløk 表示，如果超大规模现金流无法像华尔街预期的那样加速，市场可能会面临一系列风险。
